data.location: Sunset Beach Park, Downtown Vancouver's West End, Vancouver, BC
data.short_description: The Vancouver Aquatic Centre will permanently close as planned on June 28 after a BC Supreme Court judge rejected an interim injunction request to stop the closure. The Save Vancouver Aquatic Centre Society had organized rallies and raised nearly $91,000 through crowdfunding to fight the closure in court. The closure enables site preparation and demolition work to begin in Fall 2026 for a new facility.

The ribbon cutting and official opening will take place on Wednesday, July 8 at 10am.
